conventions: TypeScript strict mode with explicit types; never use any casts or @ts-ignore in production code.
Formatting follows @excalidraw/prettier-config (double quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indentation) and @excalidraw/eslint-config.
Import order: external packages first, then @excalidraw/* workspace packages (value imports before type imports), then relative imports (value imports before type imports), separated by blank lines.
Tests use Vitest and Testing Library helpers from ./test-utils and ./helpers/api and ./helpers/ui.

decisions.topic: Default value and type of boxSelectionMode in getLassoSelectedElementIds
decisions.choice: Accept optional boxSelectionMode?: "contain" | "overlap" defaulting to "overlap" when omitted.
decisions.reason: Defaulting to "overlap" preserves backwards compatibility for existing direct callers of getLassoSelectedElementIds, while literal union "contain" | "overlap" matches AppState["boxSelectionMode"] without importing off-limits ../types.

decisions.topic: Contain vs overlap geometry evaluation in getLassoSelectedElementIds
decisions.choice: In "contain" mode, select an element only when enclosureTest returns true (all points of all element segments, and any bound text segments, are inside lassoPolygon via polygonIncludesPointNonZero) and intersectionTest returns false; in "overlap" mode, select when enclosureTest returns true (any segment point inside lassoPolygon) or intersectionTest returns true.
rejected: Checking only element bounding box corners in contain mode
Skipping intersectionTest in contain mode when segment endpoints are inside the lasso polygon
decisions.reason: A concave lasso or a lasso crossing curved/long edges can include all segment endpoints while still intersecting the element outline; requiring both all segment points inside and zero outline intersections ensures true full enclosure across all shapes.

decisions.choice: Skip bound text elements (isBoundToContainer(element) whose containerId is in elementsMap) as standalone candidates, and include a container's bound text segments and bounds in the container's own contain/overlap evaluation.
rejected: Evaluating bound text independently in the element loop during contain mode
decisions.reason: In contain mode, a lasso enclosing only bound text inside a container must not select the container via LassoTrail.selectElementsFromIds; in overlap mode, touching or enclosing bound text selects the container.
